translate_en|mods/HoldCrouchToSit/42/med: Show an auto-walk icon above the character
Shows the vanilla auto-walk icon above the character while auto-walk is on, whichever way it was turned on (double-tap or the radial menu).
Hide "Sit on ground" in the right-click menu
Removes the vanilla "Sit on ground" entry from the right-click menu. Sitting by holding the Crouch key keeps working.
How long the Crouch key must be held to sit / stand. On a controller the effective minimum is 400ms.
